item.text: {"abstain":false,"blocker_patterns":["No module named (?P<id>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63})"],"explanation":"A Python test command is blocked when its interpreter reports a missing module and is remediated by successfully installing the corresponding python3 module package.","remediation_patterns":["python3-(?P<id>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63})"],"rule_id":"python_test_missing_module_package","scope_patterns":["^[a-z0-9 -]{0,16}pytest[ a-z0-9-]{0,16}$"]}
